simple.summary: מָדוֹן (Mâdôwn) means Madon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 11 1.

definitions.full: H4068. Madon II. מָדוֺן proper name, of a location a royal city of the Canaanites Josh 11:1 ; 12:19 ; ᵐ5 Μαρρων , Μαδων , Λαμορων ; = Madîn close to Hattîn , Survey i. 365, dubious ; a village Maron lies 2 hours west-southwest from Kedesh, van de Velde Mem. 146 , compare Di.
